title: 第3章 救人
slug: 似锦全本免费-似锦最新章节列表
content_zh:
季崇易显然不会水，随着水面起伏一边挣扎一边喊道：“救命……救命……”
姜似紧紧盯着在水中挣扎的二人，一推阿蛮：“按着先前的计划行事！”
阿蛮如梦初醒，飞快解开包袱拿出藏在里面的一面小铜锣，把包袱塞给姜似，扭身便跑。
姜似也不敢耽搁，拎着包袱跑到不远处的茅草伞亭那里，取出水囊了菜油的茅草立刻被点燃，很快整个茅草伞亭就被火舌吞没。
湖边这样的茅草伞亭有七八个，都是临湖垂钓的人嫌夏日日头太烤人搭建的。
姜似点燃第二个茅草伞亭时锣声响了起来，伴随着慌乱的喊声：“走水啦，走水啦——”
很快离湖边不远的民宅陆续亮起了灯，男女老幼纷纷拿着盛水的物件跑了出来。
这个时候的人格外怕走水，往往有人喊走水了，便会一涌而出去救火。
见事情按着预料的发展，姜似松了口气，连手中包袱都丢进了火中。
她不敢点燃太多茅草伞亭，不然真的引发大火就是罪过了。
水中挣扎声渐渐弱了，姜似捏紧拳头望向那里。
重生回来之后她曾经想过，到了这一晚悄悄来到这里，干脆等季崇易跳湖后拿根竹竿等着，只要他冒出头来就用竹竿戳一戳，成全他与心上人殉情的心愿好了。
这样的话，这两个人能化蝶双飞，她也不用嫁过去守活寡继而遭遇那些不幸了。
可是认真想了想，还是作罢。
季崇易只是不心悦她，却罪不至死，更重要的是，要是他就这么死了，她就要背上克夫的名声。
重活一世，姜似虽然对虚名已经看开，却不意味着愿意为别人犯蠢的行为付出代价。
所以季崇易不但不能死，巧娘她也要救。
这两个人活着，她就有了光明正大退亲的理由。
看着水中上下起伏的二人，姜似开始紧张起来。
她并不担心季崇易，既然前一世季崇易没有死，这一次应该还是会没事的，可是巧娘却不同。

前一世，巧娘连尸首都没被捞上来。
“着火了，是湖边着火了！”不远处传来人们的叫喊，人群往这个方向涌来。
姜似紧绷的心神随之一松。
只要这些人赶过来，就能发现落水的二人，她便能全身而退了。
可就在这时，一阵强风刮来，很快刮到湖面上，带起一股气流。
借着皎皎月色，姜似分明看到季崇易与巧娘之间出现一个漩涡，紧接着巧娘便沉了下去，再也没有浮起来。
姜似心中一紧，跑到大石后迅速脱下外衫，露出银灰色的紧身衣。
那是鱼皮缝制的水靠，月光下泛着银辉，越发显出少女不盈一握的纤腰。
少女如一尾美人鱼悄然入水，往巧娘下沉的位置游去。
初夏的夜晚，湖水有些凉，抚摸着少女裸露在外的柔嫩肌肤，令她不由打了一个冷颤。
姜似整个人沉入水中，中途换了口气又沉下去，勉强能看到巧娘在水中载沉载浮。
她快速游过去，伸手抓住了巧娘脚踝，拖着她往湖边游去。
姜似不过十五岁，虽然水性不错，力气却不足，浑身湿透的巧娘对她来说仿佛有千斤重。
她用力咬着唇，连下唇咬出血来都丝毫不觉，等终于到了湖边，已经快脱力了。
那些来救火的人已经奔到了湖边忙着打水救火，隐藏在人群中的阿蛮捏着嗓子喊道：“你们快看，湖里有人！”
众人闻声望去，纷纷变色：“不好，有人落水了！”
很快就有精通水性的人接连跳入湖中前去救人。
姜似用力把昏迷不醒的巧娘往岸边一推，悄无声息潜入水中往旁处游去，隐约听到身后传来惊呼：“这里还有一个！”
没过多久季崇易与巧娘就都被救了起来。
这些住在湖边的百姓哪家都有调皮的孩子背着大人来湖里洗澡，时而便有溺水的，对溺水之人如何施救，他们自有一套办法。

姜似从另一侧游到湖边悄悄上岸，躲在树后张望着，便见两人跪坐在地上对季崇易与巧娘展开了施救。
季崇易与巧娘很快先后吐出几口水，睁开了眼睛。
人被救醒了，人们反而踟蹰了。
这一男一女不知来历，总不能随便带回家里去吧。

content_en:
Ji Chongyi obviously didn't know how to swim. As the water surface rose and fell, he struggled and shouted: "Help...help..."
Jiang Si stared closely at the two people struggling in the water, and pushed Aman: "Act according to the previous plan!"
Amanru woke up from his dream, quickly untied his baggage and took out a small gong hidden inside, gave the baggage to Jiangsi, turned around and ran away.
Jiang didn't dare to delay, so he ran to the thatched umbrella pavilion not far away with his baggage. He took out the water and filled the vegetable oil with the thatch and it was immediately ignited. Soon the entire thatched umbrella pavilion was engulfed in flames.
There are seven or eight such thatched umbrella pavilions by the lake. They were all built by fishermen near the lake who thought the summer sun was too hot.
When Jiang Si lit the second thatched umbrella pavilion, the gong sounded, accompanied by panicked shouts: "The water is gone, the water is gone—"
Soon, the lights of the houses not far from the lake were lit one after another, and men, women, old and children ran out holding objects containing water.
People at this time are particularly afraid of water leakage. When someone shouts that water is leaking, they will rush out to put out the fire.
Seeing that things developed as expected, Jiang Si breathed a sigh of relief and even threw the baggage in his hand into the fire.
She didn't dare to light too many thatched umbrella pavilions, otherwise it would be a sin to cause a fire.
The sound of struggling in the water gradually became weaker, and Jiang Si clenched his fists and looked there.
After she came back from rebirth, she once thought that if she came here quietly that night, she could just wait for Ji Chongyi to jump into the lake and wait with a bamboo pole. As soon as he popped up, she would poke him with the bamboo pole to fulfill his wish to die in love with his sweetheart.
In this case, these two people can fly together like butterflies, and she won't have to marry and remain a widow and suffer the misfortunes.
But after thinking about it seriously, I decided to give up.
Ji Chongyi just didn't like her, but his crime was not worthy of death. More importantly, if he died like this, she would have to bear the reputation of Ke Fu.
After resurrecting his life, although Jiang Si has turned his back on false fame, it does not mean that he is willing to pay the price for others' stupid behavior.
So not only could Ji Chongyi not die, but Qiao Niang also had to be saved.
With these two people alive, she would have an honest reason to break off the engagement.
Looking at the two people rising and falling in the water, Jiang Si began to become nervous.
She is not worried about Ji Chongyi. Since Ji Chongyi did not die in the previous life, he should be fine this time, but Qiao Niang is different.
In the previous life, Qiao Niang's body was not even fished out.
"It's on fire, it's on fire near the lake!" People shouted not far away, and the crowd rushed in this direction.
Jiang's tense mind relaxed.
As long as these people came over, they would find the two people who fell into the water, and she would be able to escape unscathed.
But at this moment, a strong wind blew and quickly hit the lake, bringing up a current of air.
Under the bright moonlight, Jiang Si clearly saw a whirlpool appearing between Ji Chongyi and Qiao Niang, and then Qiao Niang sank and never floated again.
Jiang Si's heart tightened, and he ran behind the big stone and quickly took off his shirt, revealing a silver-gray tights.
It was a water support sewn from fish skin. It glowed silvery in the moonlight, making the girl's slender waist even more visible.
The girl quietly entered the water like a mermaid and swam towards where Qiao Niang sank.
On an early summer night, the lake water was a little cold. Touching the girl's exposed tender skin, she couldn't help but shiver.
Jiang Si sank into the water, took a breath and sank again. He could barely see Qiao Niang floating in the water.
She swam over quickly, reached out and grabbed Qiao Niang's ankle, and dragged her towards the lake.
Jiang Si was only fifteen years old. Although she was good at water, she was not strong enough. Qiao Niang, who was soaked all over, seemed to weigh a thousand pounds to her.
She bit her lip so hard that she didn't even notice that her lower lip was bleeding. When she finally reached the lake, she was almost exhausted.
Those who came to put out the fire had already rushed to the lake and were busy fetching water to put out the fire. Aman, who was hidden in the crowd, shouted at the top of his voice: "Look, there is someone in the lake!"
When everyone heard the voice, they all changed their expressions: "No, there areSomeone fell into the water! "
Soon, people who were proficient in water skills jumped into the lake one after another to rescue people.
Jiang Si pushed the unconscious Qiao Niang to the shore, quietly dived into the water and swam to the side, when he vaguely heard an exclamation from behind him: "There's another one here! "
It didn't take long for Ji Chongyi and Qiao Niang to be rescued.
Every family living by the lake has naughty children carrying adults on their backs to take a bath in the lake. Sometimes someone drowns. They have their own way of rescuing drowning people.
Jiang Si swam to the lake from the other side and quietly landed ashore. He hid behind a tree and looked around. He saw two people kneeling on the ground to rescue Ji Chongyi and Qiao Niang.
Ji Chongyi and Qiao Niang quickly spit out some water and opened their eyes.
People were rescued, but people hesitated.
The origins of this man and woman are unknown, so they cannot be taken home casually.
